regime.label: Hawkish-hike overhang, relief rally
regime.oneLiner: Fed hike odds held firm at ~85-90% for Wednesday through the weekend, Friday's relief rally still sits on narrowing weekly breadth, and Monday's partial Hormuz deal (Bahrain boycotting) leaves the oil risk premium largely intact into FOMC week.

topNews.headline: FOMC meets Sep 15-16; a 25bp hike is now the base case at ~85-90% priced, unchanged over the weekend
topNews.actionable: This remains the single biggest scheduled catalyst for the whole book this week -- the real surprise risk is a hold, which would likely spark an outsized relief rally in miners and S-REITs given how heavily a hike is already priced.

topNews.headline: Bahrain refuses to join Monday's Iran-Oman Hormuz talks; Iran and Oman to sign a partial shipping-corridor deal anyway
topNews.actionable: A partial Gulf boycott means Monday's framework is more likely a narrow bilateral shell than a comprehensive fix -- don't expect oil to fully retrace the war premium off this meeting alone.

topNews.headline: Senate CLARITY Act cloture vote Monday: passage odds collapse from 82% to ~10-16%
topNews.actionable: Failure is largely priced in already -- the asymmetric surprise is to the upside if the bill somehow clears 60 votes Monday, the same day FOMC week begins.

topNews.headline: China's rare-earth export halt to the US and Japan deepens ahead of the Sep 24 Trump-Xi summit
topNews.actionable: Treat any pre-summit goodwill gesture from Beijing as tactical, not structural, so the ex-China rare-earth watchlist thesis stays intact even through a possible short-term relief rally.

topNews.headline: Bitcoin ETFs log 4th straight day of outflows (~$463M) as Ethereum ETFs take in $216M Friday
topNews.actionable: The BTC/ETH ETF-flow divergence suggests institutional money is currently rotating within crypto rather than exiting outright -- worth tracking into FOMC week.
